officialEn.description: Ezreal winds up before firing a powerful barrage of energy that deals massive damage to each unit it passes through (damage is reduced for minions and non-epic monsters).
officialEn.tooltip: Ezreal fires a massive energy arc that deals <magicDamage>{{ damage }} magic damage</magicDamage>. Damage to minions and non-epic jungle monsters is reduced to <magicDamage>{{ damageminionmonster }} magic damage</magicDamage>.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}
